title: Read-then-write lets concurrent transfers overdraw the account
description: The balance is read without a lock and written back from the variable, so two transfers at once both pass the check and one debit is lost.

title: The transaction is left open when a statement fails
description: Without SET XACT_ABORT ON or TRY/CATCH, an error in the second UPDATE or the INSERT does not roll back, leaving the debit applied and the transaction open.
